name: Brutalism
oneLiner: Unadorned slab layout with raw type, visible structure, and a deliberate refusal of decoration.

notes: The offset shadow is decoration and adds no contrast: text must sit on the accent or surface role, never on the shadow gap.
Ink on paper is the high-contrast pair; white on blue passes at 5.58:1 but fails for text under 14px in the pixel face.

sources.label: Palette and positioning authored for dsh-uiux; name from awesome-design-skills

primary.base: height: 52px; padding: 0 20px; border: 3px solid var(--uiux-color-text); border-radius: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-family: 'Silkscreen', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 0 var(--uiux-color-text)

secondary.base: height: 52px; padding: 0 20px; border: 3px solid var(--uiux-color-text); border-radius: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-family: 'Silkscreen', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 0 var(--uiux-color-text)

default.base: padding: 20px; border: 3px solid var(--uiux-color-text); border-radius: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 0 var(--uiux-color-text)
height: 48px; width: 100%; padding: 0 14px; border: 3px solid var(--uiux-color-text); border-radius: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 1rem

display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; border: 3px solid var(--uiux-color-text); background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-family: 'Silkscreen', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; transform: rotate(-3deg)

padding: 8px 12px; border: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-text); border-radius: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-family: 'Silkscreen', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em

do: Draw every edge: 3px borders and hard offset shadows, never a blur.
Set labels, buttons, and navigation in the pixel font, and body copy in a plain sans.
Keep one loud accent (blue) against paper and ink.
dont: Do not round a single corner.
Do not use soft shadows, gradients, blur, or transparency.
Do not set paragraphs in the pixel font — it is a display face only.
antiPatterns: A soft grey shadow on a hard-bordered card.
Body copy smaller than 16px in a pixel face.
